28277.cmd: bash -e -c snapper --in-place 2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study/README.md\012snapper --check 2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study/README.md\012uv run --offline --no-project --with cairosvg python - <<'PY'\012from pathlib import Path\012import hashlib\012import subprocess\012import sys\012import tempfile\012import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET\012import cairosvg\012from PIL import Image, ImageChops\012\012folder = Path("2026-usrse/stamped-ai-study")\012source = Path("../research/poster-context")\012for name in ("stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg", "build_initial_poster.py", "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png"):\012    assert (folder / name).read_bytes() == (source / name).read_bytes(), name\012    print("Source copy matches:", name)\012svg = folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial.svg"\012original = svg.read_bytes()\012root = ET.fromstring(original)\012assert root.tag == "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg"\012assert root.attrib["width"] == root.attrib["height"] == "44in"\012assert root.attrib["viewBox"] == "0 0 3168 3168"\012assert root.findall(".//{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}text")\012subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(folder / "build_initial_poster.py")], check=True)\012assert svg.read_bytes() == original, "Regenerated SVG differs"\012proof = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="stamped-ai-study-proof-")) / "preview.png"\012cairosvg.svg2png(url=str(svg), write_to=str(proof), output_width=1584, output_height=1584)\012with Image.open(proof) as rendered, Image.open(folder / "stamped-ai-poster-initial-preview.png") as supplied:\012    assert rendered.size == supplied.size == (1584, 1584)\012    difference = ImageChops.difference(rendered.convert("RGBA"), supplied.convert("RGBA"))\012    assert not difference.getbbox(), "Rendered preview differs from supplied preview"\012print("SVG XML, 44 × 44 inch size, editable text, and exact regeneration: valid")\012print("CairoSVG version:", cairosvg.__version__)\012print("Preview pixels match copied source; dimensions: 1584 × 1584")\012print("Rendered preview:", proof)\012print("SVG SHA-256:", hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest())\012PY
